questions.question: The LCM of 2³ × 9² × 13, 2² × 13² × 19 and 9³ × 13² × 19² is :-
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To find the LCM of numbers given in exponential form, identify all the distinct bases.

Then, take the highest power of each distinct base present across all the given expressions.

The highest powers present for each base are: 2³, 9³, 13², and 19².

Multiply these highest powers together to get the final LCM directly.

**∴ The correct answer is 2³ × 9³ × 13² × 19².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First expression = 2³ × 9² × 13

Second expression = 2² × 13² × 19

Third expression = 9³ × 13² × 19²

**Formula Used:**

LCM of exponential expressions = Product of the highest power of each distinct factor present in the expressions.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Maximum power of base 2 = max(3, 2, 0) = 3 ⇒ 2³

⇒ Maximum power of base 9 = max(2, 0, 3) = 3 ⇒ 9³

⇒ Maximum power of base 13 = max(1, 2, 2) = 2 ⇒ 13²

⇒ Maximum power of base 19 = max(0, 1, 2) = 2 ⇒ 19²

⇒ LCM = 2³ × 9³ × 13² × 19²

**∴ The correct answer is 2³ × 9³ × 13² × 19².**

**__Additional Information__**

HCF of Exponential Numbers

To find the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of numbers in exponential form, select and multiply the lowest powers of only the common bases present in all expressions.

LCM and HCF of Fractions

LCM of fractions = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators) | HCF of fractions = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators).

Relation between HCF and LCM

For any two numbers a and b, the product of their HCF and LCM is strictly equal to the product of the numbers themselves: HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b.
</p

questions.question: The salary of a worker is first increased by 8% and then it is decreased by 8%. What is the percentage change in his salary?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For equal successive percentage increase and decrease of **x%**, there is always a net decrease.

Net percentage change = −(x² ÷ 100)%

Here, x = 8%

Net change = −(8² ÷ 100)% = −(64 ÷ 100)% = −0.64%

**∴ The correct answer is 0.64%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial percentage increase = +8%

Subsequent percentage decrease = −8%

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 100
 Initial Salary
 
 
 
• 
 +8%

 
 
 108
 
 
 
• 
 −8%

 
 
 99.36
 Final Salary
 
 
 Net Change: 100 → 99.36 (−0.64%)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the initial salary of the worker be 100 units.

⇒ After an 8% increase, salary = 100 + 8 = 108 units.

⇒ After an 8% decrease on the new salary, decrease amount = 108 × (8 ÷ 100) = 8.64 units.

⇒ Final salary = 108 − 8.64 = 99.36 units.

⇒ Net decrease in salary = Initial salary − Final salary = 100 − 99.36 = 0.64 units.

⇒ Percentage change = (0.64 ÷ 100) × 100% = 0.64%.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.64%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is changed successively by x% and y%, the effective percentage change is given by the formula: [x + y + (x × y) ÷ 100]%.

Equal Increase and Decrease

If a number is first increased by x% and then decreased by x%, there is always an overall net decrease equal to (x² ÷ 100)%.

Multiplier Method

For multiple changes, Final Value = Initial Value × (1 ± x ÷ 100) × (1 ± y ÷ 100). The plus (+) sign is used for an increase and the minus (−) sign is used for a decrease.
</p

questions.question: There are 30 members in group A, 76 members in group B and 44 members in group C. All the members of these groups went to a restaurant. The average amount spent on each member of group A, B and C is ₹249, ₹168 and ₹498, respectively. The total average amount (in ₹) spent per member is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert member counts to ratio: 30 : 76 : 44 = 15 : 38 : 22 (Total parts = 75).

Let the assumed average be ₹250. The deviations for each group are −1, −82, and +248.

Net deviation = (15 × −1) + (38 × −82) + (22 × 248) = −15 − 3116 + 5456 = +2325.

Average deviation = 2325 ÷ 75 = +31.

Actual average = 250 + 31 = ₹281.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹281.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Members in groups A, B, and C are 30, 76, and 44 respectively.

Average amounts spent are ₹249, ₹168, and ₹498 respectively.

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = Total Amount Spent ÷ Total Number of Members

questions.question: A merchant fixes the marked price of his goods at 60% above the cost price. He sells his goods at 25% discount. His percentage of profit is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

We can use the successive percentage formula to find the overall effect: Net Profit % = a + b + (a × b) ÷ 100

Here, markup a = +60% and discount b = −25%.

⇒ Net Profit % = 60 − 25 + [60 × (−25)] ÷ 100

⇒ Net Profit % = 35 − 1500 ÷ 100

⇒ Net Profit % = 35 − 15 = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = 60% above Cost Price (CP)

Discount = 25% on MP

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

Profit% = [(SP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100

 Profit and Discount Relationship
 CP → MP → SP
 
 
 CP: 100
 
 
 MP: 160
 
 
 SP: 120
 
 
• 
 

 +60% Markup
 
 
• 
 

 −25% Discount
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 

 +20% Profit

**Calculations:**

Let the Cost Price (CP) of the goods be 100 units.

⇒ Marked Price (MP) = 100 + 60% of 100 = 160

⇒ Discount = 25% of 160 = (25 ÷ 100) × 160 = 40

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount = 160 − 40 = 120

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 120 − 100 = 20

⇒ Profit% = (20 ÷ 100) × 100 = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount Relation

Discount is always calculated strictly on the Marked Price (MP), not on Cost Price (CP). The final transaction price is Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount.

Successive Discount

When two successive discounts of a% and b% are given, the equivalent single discount can be calculated using the formula: [a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100]%.

Dishonest Dealer Concept

If a merchant sells goods at CP but uses a false weight, the actual Profit % is calculated as: [Error ÷ (True Weight − Error)] × 100.
</p

questions.question: The simple interest on a principal amount (in ₹) is ₹191 for a period of 5 years at the rate of 2% per annum. The principal amount (in ₹) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The total effective interest rate for simple interest is calculated as R × T.

Effective interest rate = 2% × 5 = 10%.

We are given that 10% of the Principal equals ₹191.

To find the total Principal amount (which represents 100%), we multiply the given interest by 10.

Principal = 191 × 10 = 1910

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1910.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹191

Time period (T) = 5 years

Rate of interest (R) = 2% per annum

 
 Principal
 P = ?

 
 Simple Interest
 ₹191

 
• 
 

 
 Time = 5 Years
 Rate = 2% p.a.
 
 Total Interest = P × R × T ÷ 100

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ 191 = (P × 2 × 5) ÷ 100

⇒ 191 = (P × 10) ÷ 100

⇒ 191 = P ÷ 10

⇒ P = 191 × 10

⇒ P = 1910

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1910.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

In simple interest, the interest is calculated only on the initial principal amount throughout the entire period. The fundamental formula is SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Total Amount (A)

The total amount paid or received at the end of the time period is the sum of the borrowed principal and the interest earned. Formula: A = P + SI.

Compound Interest (CI)

Unlike simple interest, compound interest is calculated on both the initial principal and the accumulated interest from previous periods. Formula: A = P(1 + R/100)T.

Total Time = (1320 ÷ 528) + (1760 ÷ 352) + (2095 ÷ 419) = 2.5 + 5 + 5 = 12.5 hours.

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time = 5175 ÷ 12.5 = 414 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 414 km/h.**

questions.question: David has two grandsons Rodney and Amit. 15 year old Rodney gets some money from David’s wealth and 16 year old Amit gets rest of the money. But Rodney and Amit will get money only when they turn 22 years old. Till then the money is in a bank getting interest at rate 8% compounded annually. When both turn 22, they receive the same amount. How much had David given Amit (in ₹) initially, if total money with David was ₹23400 ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time for Rodney = 22 − 15 = 7 years and Time for Amit = 22 − 16 = 6 years.

Time difference = 1 year. Since Amit's money compounds for 1 year less, his principal must be larger by the 1-year interest multiplier.

Ratio of shares (Amit : Rodney) = (100 + 8) : 100 = 108 : 100 = 27 : 25.

Total ratio parts = 27 + 25 = 52 parts → ₹23400.

Amit's share (27 parts) = (23400 ÷ 52) × 27 = 450 × 27 = ₹12150.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12150.**

questions.question: A and B working separately can finish a work in 18 days and 24 days, respectively. A begins the work and works for two consecutive days, while B works on the 3rd day. This pattern is continued till the work is completed. In how many days will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(18, 24) = 72 units.

Efficiency: A = 4 units/day, B = 3 units/day.

Work done in one 3-day cycle (A, A, B) = 4 + 4 + 3 = 11 units.

6 cycles (18 days) complete = 6 × 11 = 66 units. Remaining = 72 − 66 = 6 units.

Day 19: A does 4 units. Remaining = 2 units. Day 20: A takes 2 ÷ 4 = 1/2 day.

**∴ The correct answer is 19 ¹/₂ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 18 days

Time taken by B = 24 days

Working cycle: A works for 2 consecutive days, and B works on the 3rd day.

**Method Used:**

We use the LCM method to find the total work and the efficiency of each person.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 18
 72
 4
 
 

 B
 24
 3
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Work done in a single 3-day cycle = (Work by A for 2 days) + (Work by B for 1 day)

⇒ Work done in 3 days = (2 × 4) + (1 × 3) = 8 + 3 = 11 units

⇒ Number of full cycles required to approach the total work = 72 ÷ 11 ≈ 6 cycles

⇒ Work done in 6 cycles (18 days) = 6 × 11 = 66 units

⇒ Remaining work = 72 − 66 = 6 units

⇒ On the 19th day (start of the 7th cycle), A works and completes 4 units of work.

⇒ Work remaining after the 19th day = 6 − 4 = 2 units

⇒ On the 20th day, A works again. Time taken by A to complete the remaining 2 units = 2 ÷ 4 = 1/2 day.

⇒ Total time taken to complete the entire work = 18 + 1 + 1/2 = 19 ¹/₂ days.

**∴ The correct answer is 19 ¹/₂ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Method for Time & Work

Total work is assumed as the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of the given individual times. Efficiency represents the work done per day, calculated as (Total Work ÷ Total Days).

Cyclic or Alternate Day Work Pattern

For repetitive work patterns, group the days into a single block or cycle where the pattern repeats. Multiply the total work done in one cycle to get as close to the overall work as possible without exceeding it. Then calculate the remaining units manually day-by-day based on who is scheduled to work.
</p

questions.question: Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-3) × 9
questions.solution:

Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-3) × 9

**Formula used:**

Follow BODMAS rule: Brackets, Orders (exponents), Division and Multiplication (from left to right), Addition and Subtraction (from left to right).

**Calculation:**

Expression: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-3) × 9

⇒ (-9) - [(-60) ÷ (-15)] + [(-3) × 9]

⇒ (-9) - [4] + [-27]

⇒ (-9) - 4 - 27

⇒ -9 - 4 = -13

⇒ -13 - 27 = -40

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: The population of a district is 333000, out of which 213000 are males. 71% of the population is literate. If 71% males are literate, then what percentage of females are literate?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If a group is divided into two parts and the overall percentage is equal to the percentage in one part, then the percentage in the second part must be exactly the same.

⇒ Overall literate population = 71%

⇒ Literate males = 71%

⇒ Literate females must also be = 71%

**∴ The correct answer is 71%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Total population = 333000

⇒ Number of males = 213000

⇒ Overall literate population = 71%

⇒ Literate males = 71%

 

 

 
 
 Total Population = 333,000
 Literate = 71%

 
 Males = 213,000
 Literate = 71%

 
 Females = 120,000
 Literate = ? %
 
 Total Literate = Literate Males + Literate Females

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total females = Total population − Total males

⇒ Total females = 333000 − 213000 = 120000

⇒ Literate population = (71 ÷ 100) × 333000 = 236430

⇒ Literate males = (71 ÷ 100) × 213000 = 151230

⇒ Literate females = Total literate − Literate males

⇒ Literate females = 236430 − 151230 = 85200

⇒ Percentage of literate females = (Literate females ÷ Total females) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (85200 ÷ 120000) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 0.71 × 100 = 71%

**∴ The correct answer is 71%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average in Mixtures

When a group is divided into components A and B, the overall percentage is given by the weighted average formula: Overall % = (ValueA × %A + ValueB × %B) ÷ (ValueA + ValueB).

Constant Percentage Rule

If two different groups have the exact same percentage of a specific characteristic, any combination or total mixture of these groups will naturally possess that exact same percentage without needing further calculation.
</p

questions.question: What is the smallest number which is when increased by 5 is divisible by 18, 30, 36 and 24?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The required number when increased by 5 must be perfectly divisible by all the given numbers.

Instead of calculating the LCM, add 5 to the given options and check for divisibility by 18 (i.e., by 9 and 2).

Option 1: 355 + 5 = 360 (Divisible by 9 and 2)

No other option yields a number that is perfectly divisible by 9 and 2 when increased by 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 355.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers are 18, 30, 36, and 24.

**Formula Used:**

Required Number = LCM(18, 30, 36, 24) − 5

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of the given numbers:

⇒ 18 = 2 × 3²

⇒ 30 = 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ 36 = 2² × 3²

⇒ 24 = 2³ × 3

⇒ The LCM is the product of the highest powers of all prime factors.

⇒ LCM = 2³ × 3² × 5

⇒ LCM = 8 × 9 × 5 = 360

⇒ The required number is 5 less than the LCM.

⇒ Required number = 360 − 5 = 355

**∴ The correct answer is 355.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

The smallest number that is a multiple of two or more given numbers. It contains the highest power of each prime factor involved.

Divisibility Rule of 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is perfectly divisible by 9. This rule is extremely helpful for quick option elimination without calculating the LCM.

Number System Rule for Remainders

The smallest number which when divided by x, y, z leaves a remainder R in each case is calculated as: LCM(x, y, z) + R.
</p

questions.question: What will be difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town, whose current population is 100000 and which is increasing at a rate of 25% every year?
questions.solution:

Since the population increases by 25% (fractional value = 1/4), it becomes 5/4 times each year.

To find the previous years' population, we multiply by the inverse factor 4/5.

Population 2 years ago = 100000 × (4/5) × (4/5) = 64000

Population 3 years ago = 64000 × (4/5) = 51200

Difference = 64000 − 51200 = 12800

**∴ The correct answer is 12800.**

questions.question: A dishonest shopkeeper promises to sell his goods at cost price. However, he uses a weight that actually weighs 37% less than what is written on it. Find his profit percentage.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In cases of dishonest weighing where goods are sold at cost price:

Profit % = [Error ÷ (True Value − Error)] × 100

Here, Error = 37% and True Value = 100%

Profit % = [37 ÷ (100 − 37)] × 100 = (37 ÷ 63) × 100

Profit % = 3700 ÷ 63 = 58 ⁴⁶/₆₃%

**∴ The correct answer is 58 ⁴⁶/₆₃%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Promised selling price = Cost price (CP)

questions.question: Two trains are moving in opposite directions at speeds of 80 km/h and 70 km/h. The length of one train is 180 m. The time taken by them to cross each other is 19 seconds. The length (in m) of the other train, correct to 2 decimal places, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed of trains in opposite directions = 80 + 70 = 150 km/h.

Relative speed in m/s = 150 × (5/18) = 125/3 m/s.

Total distance covered in 19 seconds = Speed × Time = (125/3) × 19 = 2375/3 m ≈ 791.66 m.

Length of the second train = Total distance − Length of the first train.

Length of the second train = 791.66 − 180 = 611.66 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 611.66 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Train 1 (S₁) = 80 km/h

Speed of Train 2 (S₂) = 70 km/h

Length of Train 1 (L₁) = 180 m

Time taken to cross (T) = 19 s

**Formula Used:**

Total Distance = Relative Speed × Time

When moving in opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂

 
 
• 
 
 
 
 180 m
 
• 
 

 80 km/h

 
 
 L2 = ?
 
• 
 

 70 km/h
 
 
 Opposite Directions → Speeds Add Up
 Relative Speed = 150 km/h
 Time to Cross = 19 s

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative Speed = 80 + 70 = 150 km/h

⇒ Relative Speed in m/s = 150 × (5 / 18) = 125 / 3 m/s

⇒ Total Distance = (125 / 3) × 19

⇒ Total Distance = 2375 / 3 m

⇒ L₁ + L₂ = 791.66 m

⇒ 180 + L₂ = 791.66 m

⇒ L₂ = 791.66 − 180

⇒ L₂ = 611.66 m

**∴ The correct answer is 611.66 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds. Relative Speed = |S₁ − S₂|.

Relative Speed in Opposite Direction

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds. Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.

Crossing a Stationary Object

To cross a stationary pole or a standing man, the distance covered is exactly equal to the length of the train (L). Time taken = L ÷ S.

Speed Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert speed from m/s to km/h, multiply the value by 18/5.
</p

questions.question: A square field has its area equal to 252 m² . Find its perimeter
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Perimeter of a square = 4 × √Area

Perimeter = 4 × √252

Perimeter = 4 × √(36 × 7)

Perimeter = 4 × 6√7 = 24√7 m

**∴ The correct answer is 24√7 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of the square field = 252 m²

**Formula Used:**

Area of a square = a² (where a is the side of the square)

Perimeter of a square = 4a

 
 Side (a) = 6√7 m
 a
 Area = 252 m²
 Perimeter = 4 × a = 24√7 m

**Calculations:**

⇒ a² = 252

⇒ a = √252

⇒ a = √(36 × 7)

⇒ a = 6√7 m

⇒ Perimeter = 4 × a

⇒ Perimeter = 4 × 6√7

⇒ Perimeter = 24√7 m

**∴ The correct answer is 24√7 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Diagonal of a Square

The diagonal 'd' of a square with side 'a' is given by d = a√2.

Area in terms of Diagonal

The area of a square can also be calculated directly from its diagonal using the formula Area = d² ÷ 2.

Incircle and Circumcircle

For a square of side 'a', the radius of the inscribed circle is a ÷ 2, and the radius of the circumscribed circle is a ÷ √2.

questions.question: A profit earned when an item is sold for ₹4,000 is ten times the loss incurred when it is sold for ₹ 2,790. At what price should the item be sold if it is desired to make a profit of 20%?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference between the two selling prices = ₹4,000 − ₹2,790 = ₹1,210.

Ratio of Profit to Loss = 10 : 1. Total parts = 10 + 1 = 11 parts.

11 parts = 1,210 ⇒ 1 part (Loss) = 1,210 ÷ 11 = ₹110.

Cost Price (CP) = ₹2,790 + ₹110 = ₹2,900.

Selling Price for 20% profit = ₹2,900 × 1.20 = ₹3,480.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,480.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price 1 (SP₁) = ₹2,790 (Loss incurred)

Selling Price 2 (SP₂) = ₹4,000 (Profit earned)

Profit = 10

questions.question: If p varies directly to q and p₁ = 15, q₁ = 630, and p₂ = 6, then find the value of q₂ .
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In direct variation, q is a constant multiple of p.

Constant multiple = q₁ ÷ p₁ = 630 ÷ 15 = 42

Therefore, q₂ = p₂ × 42

⇒ q₂ = 6 × 42 = 252

**∴ The correct answer is 252.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

p₁ = 15, q₁ = 630

p₂ = 6

**Formula Used:**

If p varies directly to q, then p ∝ q

⇒ p₁ / q₁ = p₂ / q₂

 
 
 
 
 
 p₁ = 15
 p₂ = 6
 q₁ = 630
 q₂ = ?
 
 =
 
• 
 
• 
 
 Direct Variation : p₁ / q₁ = p₂ / q₂

**Calculation:**

⇒ 15 / 630 = 6 / q₂

⇒ 1 / 42 = 6 / q₂

⇒ q₂ = 42 × 6

⇒ q₂ = 252

**∴ The correct answer is 252.**

**__Additional Information__**

Direct Variation

When two variables change in the same direction at a constant rate, it is direct variation (e.g., p ∝ q ⇒ p / q = k).

Inverse Variation

When an increase in one variable results in a proportional decrease in the other, it is inverse variation (e.g., p ∝ 1 / q ⇒ p × q = k).

Joint Variation

When a quantity varies directly with the product of two or more other quantities, it is called joint variation (e.g., p ∝ q × r ⇒ p = k × q × r).
</p
